title: Culture of extracellular protease-producing and non-producing bacterial strains for antimicrobial activity assay
protocol: Inoculate a single colony of _P. aeruginosa_ into 10 ml of Luria-Bertani (LB) broth.
Shake the _P. aeruginosa_ culture at 200 rpm for 16 hours at 37 °C.
Dilute overnight cultures of PAO-Iglewski and PAO-B1A1 in LB broth to a concentration of 10^3 cfu/ml.
Incubate the diluted _P. aeruginosa_ cultures as standing cultures at 37 °C for 48 hours.
Inoculate a single colony of _S. aureus_ into 10 ml of Tryptone Soy Broth (TSB).
Shake the culture at 220 rpm, 37 °C for 4 hours after diluting to an OD600nm of 1.0.
Dilute overnight cultures of naturally occurring _Bacillus_ species with marine broth until OD600nm reaches 0.5.
Shake the diluted _Bacillus_ culture at 220 rpm, 37 °C for 2 hours.
Collect bacterial cultures by centrifugation at 8000 x g for 10 minutes.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.22 μm pore-sized membrane filter.
Measure soluble protease activity in the filtered bacterium-free culture medium using the Azocoll protease assay.
